Bracing Drone.name: Bracing Drone
Bracing Drone.description: The user presses a hand to a cracking wall or a shifting rubble pile and holds a low vocal drone whose vibration locks loose stone in place across a room-sized collapse. For the rest of the scene no slab there slides further while rescuers pull people out, and the returning hum tells the user if a beam starts to give. It steadies a single room rather than a whole building, and the user cannot move or speak while holding it. Strain: severe.
